releaseNotes:
• Fixed Complete button behavior for checklist notes.
• Fixed Floating Dot delete confirmation crash.
• Added reminder option in Quick Pad.
• Added restore functionality for archived notes.
• Updated default theme to Light + Rose Pink.
• Improved app stability and reliability.

Install the APK directly. Your existing app can be updated without uninstalling it.
Note: Do not uninstall the existing app, as it may remove locally stored notes.
